result:
I've fixed F-DG2-220. The full `pnpm test` passed in all 18 repeated runs: 10 on Node 24, 5 on Node 22, and 3 under CPU load, each with 638/638 tests and exit 0.

**Cause:** Many web unit tests render the whole app and then wait for a control using Testing Library's default 1000 ms timeout. Under full-suite load the Diagnose page sometimes took longer than that to load, so the wait gave up even though the page was fine.

**Fix:**
- **Wait timeout for all web unit tests:** a new setup file, `apps/web/test/setup.ts`, raises the `findBy*` / `waitFor` timeout to 5000 ms (with a comment citing F-DG2-220). It is wired into `apps/web/vitest.config.ts` with `setupFiles`.
- **Per-test timeout:** set to 20 s in the same config, so a wait that never resolves still fails with Testing Library's own "Unable to find …" message. A throwaway probe (deleted afterwards) failed at 5017 ms with exactly that message.
- **Guard test:** `apps/web/src/test/harness-config.test.ts` fails if someone removes the setting or lowers either timeout.
- **Faster `p2-blank-forms.test.tsx`:** the Diagnose and Design tests now wait for the record's table row once and only search inside it. The file's test time dropped from 17.3 s to 8.9 s, and its slowest test in the full-suite runs is 451 ms (QA measured 2121 ms in round 4). The assertions are unchanged.

**Sweep:**
- Every other web test file that waits on a page load is covered by the new setting, and none uses fake timers.
- With `--reporter=verbose`, only one test went over 1.5 s: the API architecture test, at 1560 ms on Node 22. It already has an explicit 30 s timeout, so it is far from its limit, and it's under `apps/api/**`, which I may not edit.

**Repeated runs:**

| Runs | Result | Duration each |
|---|---|---|
| 10 on Node 24 | 10/10 passed | 22.2–23.5 s |
| 5 on Node 22 | 5/5 passed | 24.8–25.9 s |
| 3 on Node 24 under CPU load | 3/3 passed | 31.2–32.0 s |

For the load runs I used two busy-loop processes on the 4 cores rather than a parallel build in a second clone; the assignment allows either. I only ran them on Node 24.

**Other checks:**
- **Pass:** `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint` and `node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG1` (`PASS gate DG1 (historical)`) all exited 0.
- **`pnpm format:check`:** exited 2 only because the sandbox blocks reading 12 untracked dotfiles. It reported no formatting problems, and the `--ignore-path` variant that skips those files exited 0.

No product screens changed, so there are no screenshots, and nothing in this work grants any business or gate approval.

The handback is `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/T-DG2-FE7-frontend-ux-engineer.md`. The logs are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/T-DG2-FE7-evidence/`.
